attrs.evidence: The proposition the shipped Periodic Table cell has been carrying, given its own claim_id so that the STRONGER cross-transition proposition can have a different one. GPT-5.6's rename, adopted. NOTE WHAT IS NOT HAPPENING HERE: the shipped cell keeps its identity and its text, and this is a new record for a proposition that was previously conflated with a second one. A claim_id preserves PROPOSITION identity — the rule GPT-5.6 itself established when it rejected Fable's CLAIMS_DELTA.json wholesale for reusing three ids on different sentences — so renaming a cell in place would be the exact move that rule forbids.
